Policy & Security Governance: Implement, update, and enforce workspace policies, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP), multi-factor authentication (2FA/MFA), session controls, and email security protocols (SPF, DKIM, DMARC). Audit, Logs & Monitoring: Monitor audit logs, track platform security alerts, investigate operational anomalies, and generate compliance reports. Incident & Operational Support: Troubleshoot identity, calendar, drive, and email routing issues; provide escalated tier-2/tier-3 administrative support. Platform Enhancement: Support administration across connected workspace tools and enterprise features (e.g., Chrome Enterprise, Google Gemini Enterprise integrations).

If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.
